lights._note: Room Review CORICORI/2 (round 1): the hole is PAINTED (floorbit10, 1ENTER), so a distant source high above it shines straight down through the ceiling in a narrow cone (no shadow test); 'air' makes the shaft show in the volumetric fog, 'rays' streaks it. Round 2 (Josh's follow-up): white at the top diffusing to a subtle orange lower down (colorFar between tintFrom and tintTo: the ceiling at 262, the floor at 362 below the source), and 'dust' = specks floating in the shaft, lit by it. Round 3: all orange (#FFB878), no blend from white.
lights._bounce: 2026-10-09 (Josh): the shaft lights the room by bounce like the torches -- a narrow beam carries little, so 3x its light goes into the bounced light (the beam itself unchanged)

gi._about: Bounced light (2026-10-09, Josh: global illumination, pre-calculated per room): the light the placed lights throw off every surface onto every other, worked out once per change of geometry, lights or these settings (cached in C:\Games\azrael-render\gi). strength = how much of it; ambient = the room's flat level while it is on, as a share of it (the bounce takes over part of what it stood in for); spacing = units between light probes; rays per probe; bounces; albedo = how much light the surfaces give back.
gi._albedo: 2.2: the original textures average 14% bright (their lighting is painted in); real stone gives back ~30%. Each surface is capped at 90%.

volume._about: Volumetric fog (2026-10-08): black air, density per unit up to max opaque; the lights (shadowed) and the flashlight light it up as they pass. scatter = how much of it catches light, lamp = the flashlight's share, anisotropy = forward glow toward a light, reach = a light's reach in the air (half as bright that far), far/steps = how far each pixel's air is marched. cut = how much the flashlight thins the fog inside its cone. level = the room's light level, held whether the flashlight is on or off.

paint._note: Room Review CORICORI/5 + /6 (round 9, Josh): the darkness the original artists painted into the textures (the corridor fading to black) made real in the fog -- thicker black where the art is painted dark. density = extra fog per unit where fully dark, max = how opaque it may get, smooth = how far the art is averaged (units), gamma = how quickly it darkens below the room's bright parts
